name: WrappedCBDC Limited
summary: Nigerian operating company and issuer of the cNGN stablecoin under Nigeria SEC regulatory oversight.
notes: WrappedCBDC Terms identify the company as incorporated in Nigeria and licensed by the Securities and Exchange Commission of Nigeria under the Regulatory Incubation Program; the cNGN AML policy also describes provisional Digital Asset Offering Platform authorization for cNGN.
